meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: Claude 把 iMessage 适配器拷入项目、注册、装依赖并构建跑测试;再让你选本地(macOS 读 chat.db)或远程(Photon)模式,写配置、重启服务,并绑定你的手机号或 Apple ID。
howto.when: 当你说「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词时触发;若正在 /setup 流程中则回到该流程,否则用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 接入。

say.text: 帮我加 iMessage,用本地模式

say.note: 把这个号码登记为你的会话地址

howto.what_en: Claude copies the iMessage adapter in, registers it, installs the pinned dep, builds and runs its test. You pick local (macOS chat.db) or remote (Photon) mode; Claude writes .env, restarts, and binds your phone/Apple ID handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" and similar phrases. Mid-/setup it returns to that flow; otherwise wire it with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.
